jamie: quick follow-up on sideplane egress patterns for callbacks.
rachel: options: regional SNAT (simple) or src-preserve via pinned ENI (costly).
sam: suggest default to regional SNAT, gate src-preserve to enterprise/dedicated. add shared-static pool as intermediate.
jamie: agree. implement graceful withdraw (30s) and observable fallback metric.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-7001: sideplane-egress-cost-estimate
